svg.title: agent-harness: the deny floor, doctor and sync-global (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: four agent commands pass through the shared dispatch.py hook. Each is parsed into argv tokens, checked against the repository tier (T2, sensitive, wall posture), and denied or allowed. Then harness doctor (illustrative checks) inspects the wiring, and sync-global previews a diff before an explicit apply with per-file timestamped backups. The floor is not a sandbox.
svg.text: shared dispatch.py hook · argv deny floor · tier.json · doctor · sync-global (diff first) · not a sandbox
server default-branch rules are a separate boundary
$ py -3 harness.py doctor · sync-global · illustrative checks
git push --mirror origin: argv parsed, tier 2 checked, floor denies it (tag-guard)
Wall posture refuses this outside-project root deletion
A ready gh pr create is allowed on tier 2
curl -q suppresses ambient config: this sample POST is allowed
doctor inspects the live wiring first. Installation is never implicit
sync-global shows the diff before it writes anything
--apply takes per-file timestamped backups; recover per file
